quotes.chinese: 我思故我在。
quotes.english: I think, therefore I am.
quotes.author: 勒内·笛卡尔

quotes.chinese: 我唯一知道的，是我一无所知。
quotes.english: I know that I am intelligent, because I know that I know nothing.
quotes.author: 苏格拉底

quotes.chinese: 受过教育的头脑的标志是能够容纳一个思想而不接受它。
quotes.english: It is the mark of an educated mind to be able to entertain a thought without accepting it.
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.chinese: 理性是且只应当是激情的奴隶。
quotes.english: Reason is, and ought only to be the slave of the passions.
quotes.author: 大卫·休谟

quotes.chinese: 常识并非那么常见。
quotes.english: Common sense is not so common.
quotes.author: 伏尔泰

quotes.chinese: 良知，人间分配得最均匀的东西。
quotes.english: Good sense is, of all things among men, the most equally distributed.
quotes.author: 勒内·笛卡尔

quotes.chinese: 判断一个人要看他的问题，而不是他的答案。
quotes.english: Judge a man by his questions rather than his answers.
quotes.author: 伏尔泰

quotes.chinese: 阅读不是为了反驳和驳斥，也不是为了相信和视为理所当然，更不是为了寻找谈资和话语，而是为了权衡和思考。
quotes.english: Read not to contradict and confute; nor to believe and take for granted; nor to find talk and discourse; but to weigh and consider.
quotes.author: 弗朗西斯·培根

quotes.chinese: 一切所言，皆可清晰。
quotes.english: Everything that can be said can be said clearly.
quotes.author: 路德维希·维特根斯坦

quotes.chinese: 有勇气运用你自己的理智！
quotes.english: Have courage to use your own understanding.
quotes.author: 伊曼努尔·康德

quotes.chinese: 理智是心灵的眼睛。
quotes.english: Reason is the eye of the soul.
quotes.author: 柏拉图

quotes.chinese: 不要因为大多数人这么做，就放弃理性。
quotes.english: Do not surrender your reason just because the majority does.
quotes.author: 阿尔贝·加缪

quotes.chinese: 理智不是冷漠，而是清醒。
quotes.english: Rationality is not indifference; it's clarity.
quotes.author: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼

quotes.chinese: 保持理智，不是压抑情感，而是管理它。
quotes.english: To be rational is not to suppress emotion, but to manage it.
quotes.author: 卡尔·荣格
quotes.source_en: The Collected Works of C.G. Jung

quotes.chinese: 所有的知识都始于经验。
quotes.english: All our knowledge begins with the senses.
quotes.author: 伊曼努尔·康德

quotes.chinese: 人显然是为了思考而生的；那是他全部的尊严和价值所在。
quotes.english: Man is obviously made for thinking. Therein lies all his dignity and his merit.
quotes.author: 布莱兹·帕斯卡

quotes.chinese: 混乱要付出代价。
quotes.english: Confusion pays the price.
quotes.author: 克罗斯比、斯蒂尔斯和纳什乐队

quotes.chinese: 没有什么比思考更有力量。
quotes.english: Nothing is more powerful than thought.
quotes.author: 奥古斯丁

quotes.chinese: 教育的作用在于引导人们勤于思考、判断性地思考。
quotes.english: The function of education is to teach one to think intensively and to think critically.
quotes.author: 马丁·路德·金

quotes.chinese: 世界上最难的事是什么？是思考。
quotes.english: What is the hardest task in the world? To think.
quotes.author: 拉尔夫·沃尔多·爱默生

quotes.chinese: 所谓明智，就是能看到言外之意，得出结论。
quotes.english: Wisdom is to see the implications and draw conclusions.
quotes.author: 《塔木德》

quotes.chinese: 除了深思熟虑，别的算不上什么真正的思考。
quotes.english: Nothing is really thought but deliberate thinking.
quotes.author: 赫伯特·乔治·威尔斯

quotes.chinese: 最渊博的人，也最清楚自己有多无知。
quotes.english: The most learned are the most aware of their ignorance.
quotes.author: 托马斯·杰斐逊

quotes.chinese: 就算5000万人都在说同一件荒谬的事，这也还是一件荒谬的事。
quotes.english: If 50 million people say a foolish thing, it is still a foolish thing.
quotes.author: 阿纳托尔·法朗士

quotes.chinese: 当所有人的想法都一样时，就意味着没有人在思考。
quotes.english: When all think alike, no one thinks very much.
quotes.author: 沃尔特·李普曼

quotes.chinese: 宇宙就是它本来的样子，而不是我所希望的样子。
quotes.english: The universe is what it is, not what I wish it to be.
quotes.author: 伯特兰·罗素

quotes.chinese: 如果你有知识，就让别人借你的光点亮他们的蜡烛。
quotes.english: If you have knowledge, let others light their candle by it.
quotes.author: 玛格丽特·富勒

quotes.chinese: 思考是世界上最艰苦的工作，这大概也是为什么很少有人愿意投身其中的原因。
quotes.english: Thinking is the hardest work there is, which is probably the reason why so few engage in it.
quotes.author: 亨利·福特

quotes.chinese: 用噪音和命令来论证的人，说明他的理性是薄弱的。
quotes.english: He who establishes his argument by noise and command shows that his reason is weak.
quotes.author: 米歇尔·德·蒙田

quotes.chinese: 许多人都以为自己在思考，其实他们只是在重新排列自己的偏见。
quotes.english: A great many people think they are thinking when they are merely rearranging their prejudices.
quotes.author: 威廉·詹姆斯

quotes.chinese: 知道你知道什么，也知道你不知道什么，这就是真正的知识。
quotes.english: To know what you know and what you do not know, that is true knowledge.
quotes.author: 孔子

quotes.chinese: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。
quotes.english: To study and not think is futile. To think and not study is dangerous.
quotes.author: 孔子

quotes.chinese: 理性是罗盘，欲望是暴风雨。
quotes.english: Reason is the compass, desire the storm.
quotes.author: 亚历山大·蒲柏

quotes.chinese: 不盲从于理论是理智的美德，而不是理智的犯罪。
quotes.english: Blind commitment to a theory is not an intellectual virtue: it is an intellectual crime.
quotes.author: 伊姆雷·拉卡托斯

quotes.chinese: 新观点总是被怀疑，通常被反对，没有别的原因，只是因为它们还不够普遍。
quotes.english: New opinions are always suspected, and usually opposed, without any other reason but because they are not already common.
quotes.author: 约翰·洛克

quotes.chinese: 逻辑能有效击退概念不清的思考。
quotes.english: Logic is a weapon against unclear thinking.
quotes.author: 约翰·斯图亚特·穆勒

quotes.chinese: 科学是组织起来的知识，智慧是组织起来的生活。
quotes.english: Science is organized knowledge. Wisdom is organized life.
quotes.author: 伊曼努尔·康德

quotes.chinese: 一切真理在被发现时都是简单的；但困难在于发现它们。
quotes.english: All truths are easy to understand once they are discovered; the point is to discover them.
quotes.author: 伽利略·伽利莱

quotes.chinese: 我不同意你的观点，但我誓死捍卫你说话的权利。
quotes.english: I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to the death your right to say it.
quotes.author: 伏尔泰

quotes.chinese: 教育不是为生活做准备；教育就是生活本身。
quotes.english: Education is not preparation for life; education is life itself.
quotes.author: 约翰·杜威

quotes.chinese: 真理是时间的女儿，不是权威的女儿。
quotes.english: Truth is the daughter of time, not of authority.
quotes.author: 弗朗西斯·培根

quotes.chinese: 认识你自己。
quotes.english: Know thyself.
quotes.author: 苏格拉底

quotes.chinese: 未经审视的人生不值得过。
quotes.english: The unexamined life is not worth living.
quotes.author: 苏格拉底

quotes.chinese: 理解是接纳的第一步，只有接纳才能有康复。
quotes.english: Understanding is the first step to acceptance, and only with acceptance can there be recovery.
quotes.author: J·K·罗琳
quotes.source_en: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

quotes.chinese: 眼睛只看到心智准备好去理解的东西。
quotes.english: The eye sees only what the mind is prepared to comprehend.
quotes.author: 亨利·柏格森

quotes.chinese: 了解自己的无知是智慧的开始。
quotes.english: The beginning of wisdom is the admission of ignorance.
quotes.author: 苏格拉底

quotes.chinese: 智慧不是学校的产物，而是终身尝试获取它的产物。
quotes.english: Wisdom is not a product of schooling but of the lifelong attempt to acquire it.
quotes.author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦

quotes.chinese: 一个人如果不能独立思考，就永远不会真正自由。
quotes.english: A person who cannot think independently is never truly free.
quotes.author: 伯特兰·罗素

quotes.chinese: 愚蠢的最大特点就是对自己无知的无知。
quotes.english: The greatest characteristic of stupidity is the ignorance of one's own ignorance.
quotes.author: 塞涅卡

quotes.chinese: 知识就是力量。
quotes.english: Knowledge is power.
quotes.author: 弗朗西斯·培根

quotes.chinese: 能够提出新的问题、新的可能性，从新的角度看待旧问题，这需要创造性的想象力，并标志着科学的真正进步。
quotes.english: To raise new questions, new possibilities, to regard old problems from a new angle requires creative imagination and marks real advances in science.
quotes.author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦

quotes.chinese: 凡事应该尽可能简单，但不能过于简单。
quotes.english: Everything should be made as simple as possible, but not simpler.
quotes.author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦

quotes.chinese: 想象力比知识更重要。
quotes.english: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
quotes.author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦

quotes.chinese: 提出一个问题往往比解决一个问题更重要。
quotes.english: The formulation of a problem is often more essential than its solution.
quotes.author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦

quotes.chinese: 最不可理解的是，这个世界竟然是可以理解的。
quotes.english: The most incomprehensible thing about the world is that it is comprehensible.
quotes.author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦

quotes.chinese: 推理错误比不合理的真相更有害。
quotes.english: Irrationally held truths may be more harmful than reasoned errors.
quotes.author: 托马斯·亨利·赫胥黎

quotes.chinese: 演绎推理是科学探索的基础。
quotes.english: Deductive reasoning is the foundation of scientific inquiry.
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.chinese: 我们不应该只相信权威，而应该通过观察和实验来验证。
quotes.english: The ultimate court of appeal is observation and experiment, not authority.
quotes.author: 托马斯·亨利·赫胥黎

quotes.chinese: 清晰的思考是解决问题的第一步。
quotes.english: Clear thinking is the first step to solving a problem.
quotes.author: 理查德·费曼

quotes.chinese: 我们的认知始于感官，然后进入理解，最后以理性告终。理性之上别无他物。
quotes.english: All our knowledge begins with the senses, proceeds then to the understanding, and ends with reason. There is nothing higher than reason.
quotes.author: 伊曼努尔·康德

quotes.chinese: 行动是通往知识的唯一道路。
quotes.english: Activity is the only road to knowledge.
quotes.author: 萧伯纳

quotes.chinese: 逻辑是思想的语法。
quotes.english: Logic is the grammar of thought.
quotes.author: 约翰·斯图亚特·穆勒

quotes.chinese: 真理是哲学的目的。
quotes.english: Truth is the aim of philosophy.
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.chinese: 习惯和范例比任何调查都更有说服力。
quotes.english: Custom and example are more persuasive than any investigation.
quotes.author: 勒内·笛卡尔

quotes.chinese: 人总是听到自己想听到的而忽略其他。
quotes.english: People hear what they want to hear and ignore the rest.
quotes.author: 保罗·西蒙

quotes.chinese: 世界上最简单的事就是欺骗自己，因为一个人总是会认为，自己所希望的就是真的。
quotes.english: Nothing is easier than self-deceit. For what each man wishes, that he also believes to be true.
quotes.author: 狄摩西尼

quotes.chinese: 思想保守意味着提前进入理智晚期。
quotes.english: Conservatism of thought is a premature senility of the intellect.
quotes.author: 约翰·杜威

quotes.chinese: 教育的主要目的在于能进行实践性和思考性的判断。
quotes.english: The main purpose of education is to enable practical and critical judgment.
quotes.author: 布兰德·布兰查德

quotes.chinese: 世界上最难的事是思考。
quotes.english: The hardest thing in the world is to think.
quotes.author: 拉尔夫·沃尔多·爱默生

quotes.chinese: 人类为自己而思考。
quotes.english: Human beings think for themselves.
quotes.author: 德尼·狄德罗

quotes.chinese: 只有受过教育的人才是自由的。
quotes.english: Only the educated are free.
quotes.author: 爱比克泰德

quotes.chinese: 恐惧是理性的最大敌人。
quotes.english: Fear is the greatest enemy of reason.
quotes.author: 塞涅卡

quotes.chinese: 真正的智慧是知道自己的无知。
quotes.english: True wisdom is knowing that you know nothing.
quotes.author: 苏格拉底

quotes.chinese: 理性思考的一个重要特征就是不要绝对肯定。
quotes.english: Not to be absolutely certain is an important feature of rational thinking.
quotes.author: 伯特兰·罗素

quotes.chinese: 归纳推理是从个别事实到一般结论的推理。
quotes.english: Inductive reasoning is reasoning from particular facts to general conclusions.
quotes.author: 弗朗西斯·培根

quotes.chinese: 演绎推理是从一般前提到个别结论的推理。
quotes.english: Deductive reasoning is reasoning from general premises to particular conclusions.
quotes.author: 亚里士多德

quotes.chinese: 经验是最好的老师。
quotes.english: Experience is the best teacher.
quotes.author: 老加图

quotes.chinese: 知识是智慧的开端。
quotes.english: Knowledge is the beginning of wisdom.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 智慧的价值胜过珍珠。
quotes.english: The value of wisdom is more than pearls.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 畏惧耶和华是知识的开端。
quotes.english: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。
quotes.english: Fools despise wisdom and instruction.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 智慧人大有能力，有知识的人力上加力。
quotes.english: A wise man has great power, and a man of knowledge increases strength.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 愚昧人若静默不言，也可算为智慧。
quotes.english: Even a fool who keeps silent is considered wise.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 知识使人自高自大，惟有爱心能造就人。
quotes.english: Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
quotes.author: 使徒保罗

quotes.chinese: 如今常存的有信、有望、有爱；这三样，其中最大的是爱。
quotes.english: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.
quotes.author: 使徒保罗

quotes.chinese: 不要效法这个世界，只要心意更新而变化。
quotes.english: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
quotes.author: 使徒保罗

quotes.chinese: 你们必晓得真理，真理必叫你们得以自由。
quotes.english: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
quotes.author: 耶稣基督

quotes.chinese: 寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。
quotes.english: Seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.
quotes.author: 耶稣基督

quotes.chinese: 我们如今仿佛对着镜子观看，模糊不清，到那时就要面对面了。
quotes.english: For now we see only a reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face.
quotes.author: 使徒保罗

quotes.chinese: 与智慧人同行的，必得智慧。
quotes.english: Walk with the wise and become wise.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 智慧人的舌，善发知识。
quotes.english: The tongue of the wise adorns knowledge.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 聪明人的心得知识，智慧人的耳求知识。
quotes.english: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 愚昧人张嘴启争端，开口招鞭打。
quotes.english: Fools find no pleasure in understanding but delight in airing their own opinions.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 未曾听完先回答的，便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
quotes.english: To answer before listening—that is folly and shame.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 人心怀藏谋略，好像深水，惟明哲人才能汲引出来。
quotes.english: The purposes of a person's heart are deep waters, but one who has insight draws them out.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 骄傲在败坏以先，狂心在跌倒之前。
quotes.english: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 心存邪僻的，寻不着好处。
quotes.english: A person with a perverse heart finds no good.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 聪明人的心得知识。
quotes.english: The heart of the wise acquires knowledge.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 智慧人的法则，是生命的泉源。
quotes.english: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life.
quotes.author: 所罗门

quotes.chinese: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端，认识至圣者便是聪明。
quotes.english: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
quotes.author: 所罗门
